description: This file defines a C# class 'BasketViewModel' used in the Web.Pages.Basket namespace, representing the view model for a shopping basket in an e-commerce web application.

classes.name: BasketViewModel
classes.description: A view model class for representing the shopping basket, including properties like Id, Items, BuyerId, and a method to calculate the total price.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of items in the basket by summing up unit price times quantity for each item, rounded to two decimal places.
